zh: 每个原始元素要么单独保留，要么和相邻的一个元素拼成一项，这相当于把数组切成若干长度为 1 或 2 的段。
设前 i 个元素的最大总和为 f[i]。最后一段要么只含第 i 个元素，要么是第 i−1 个和第 i 个元素拼接，所以 f[i] 只依赖 f[i−1] 和 f[i−2]。
拼接 x 和 y 的值等于 x 乘以 10 的“y 的位数”次方再加 y，0 也算一位。递推取 f[i−1]+a[i] 与 f[i−2]+拼接值 中的较大者，只保留最近两个状态和上一个元素即可，最后输出 f[N]；总和可能超过 32 位整数。
en: Each original element is either kept alone or joined with one neighbor, which is the same as cutting the array into pieces of length 1 or 2.
Let f[i] be the best total for the first i elements. The last piece is either element i alone or elements i−1 and i concatenated, so f[i] depends only on f[i−1] and f[i−2].

Concatenating x and y gives x times 10 to the power of the digit count of y, plus y, where 0 counts as one digit. Take the larger of f[i−1]+a[i] and f[i−2]+the concatenated value, keep only the last two states and the previous element, and print f[N]; the total can exceed 32-bit range.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Prefix DP: either keep the last element on its own, or concatenate the last two original elements into one item; take the larger of the two sums.

## Correctness

In any valid partition, the last group can contain only 1 or 2 original elements. Removing it leaves a valid optimal subproblem on a shorter prefix; the two recurrences exhaust all possibilities and guarantee no overlap.

## Complexity

Time O(N), space O(1) apart from the input.
